Use case: productivity-visual. Create ONE polished 16:9 landscape third pitch slide for Sachet, consistent with white minimal slides and orange restrained accents. Centered title "The User & the Decision" with54pt-equivalent size. Centered two-line main statement at32pt-equivalent EXACT "An unexpected fee creates a payment decision." and "Sachet helps the user examine the evidence before proceeding." Include a compact full-width user context line "Primary user: an individual deciding whether to make a UPI, banking, or wallet payment." Add scenario context "Goal: withdraw claimed funds. New request: pay a processing fee first."
Attached images are REAL PROTOTYPE SCREENSHOTS, not generic UI references. Image1 is genuine submission modal, Image2 is genuine assessment page including source evidence and verification action, Image3 is genuine correction modal. Use these supplied captures as the screen images, retain their actual UI color (subtle green/cream), exact content and recognizable appearance, crop margins/background as needed to focus readable UI. Do NOT invent a mobile app, imaginary dashboard, fictional features, fake risk score, fake payment interface or new UI. Do not repaint screenshots orange; orange applies to slide annotations only. Screenshot2 can be cropped to current assessment, Your next step, and Why this needs a look panels on right to improve legibility. Screenshot1 focus actual central submission modal. Screenshot3 focus actual central correction modal. Actual screenshot content should remain faithful; do not fabricate more screens. Screens dominate at least55% slide. No pictogram decoration, no cartoon user, no avatar icon additions, no bottom orange strip. Sufficient explanatory text, not empty. Captions:
"01  Share the interaction"
"Submit selected messages and explain the intended outcome."
"02  Inspect the concern"
"See the payment condition, exact supporting quote, and verification guidance."
"03  Verify or clarify"
"Verify independently, add context, or correct an interpretation."
Small footer "Sachet · Team ANKOR" left and "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2" right. Small subtle note "Prototype shown with synthetic test material." All referenced UI images use underlying original screenshots not invented concepts.
